_comment: Template: Create the QAR template workbook from model files.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar qar-template --config this-file.json
_note_models: Model files (.xml) or .zip archives of them.
_note_output: The workbook: FileName, FileProfile, MAS, FileID, sorted by MAS then file name.
